tasks.title: Set up project environment and dependencies
tasks.description: Initialize the project with Godot 4.5.1 .NET, .NET 8 SDK, and ensure packages.lock.json is present.
tasks.details: Install Godot 4.5.1 .NET console binary, set GODOT_BIN environment variable. Ensure .NET 8 SDK is installed. Run 'dotnet restore .\NewRouge.sln' to generate packages.lock.json if missing. Verify UTF-8 encoding and Windows-only compliance. Create logs/ directory structure for evidence. Refs: ADR-0031, ADR-0011.
tasks.testStrategy: Check Godot version via '& $env:GODOT_BIN --version' as required evidence, check .NET version via 'dotnet --version', and verify packages.lock.json exists. If PATH is configured, 'godot --version' may be captured as optional supplementary evidence. Log environment evidence to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/. Refs: ADR-0031, ADR-0011.
tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down this task with a focus on Set up project environment and dependencies.

tasks.title: Create core project structure and namespaces
tasks.description: Establish directory boundaries: Game.Core, Game.Godot, Game.Core.Tests, Tests.Godot. Enforce NewRouge.* namespace.
tasks.details: Create directories: Game.Core/, Game.Godot/, Game.Core.Tests/, Tests.Godot/. Set up C# projects for Game.Core, Game.Core.Tests, and Tests.Godot with net8.0 target and Nullable enabled. Treat Game.Godot as script/resource directory under the root project (no standalone csproj). Ensure Game.Core does not reference Godot API. Use taskdoc/task-0002-change-set.json as authoritative Task 2 C# scope and enforce NewRouge.* namespace for listed files while allowing Game.* coexistence outside Task 2 scope. Refs: ADR-0024.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate root directories and .csproj settings for Game.Core, Game.Core.Tests, and Tests.Godot. Verify Game.Godot behaves as script/resource directory. Use acceptance gate dotnet-build-warnaserror as the root build proof; if this gate is not executed or fails, Task 2 cannot be marked done. Refs: ADR-0024.
tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down this task with a focus on Create core project structure and namespaces.

tasks.title: Implement core contracts for card identity and forms
tasks.description: Define contracts in Game.Core/Contracts for card identity, forms (Base, U1A, U1B, Ultimate), and upgrade fields per ADR-0033.
tasks.details: Create interfaces/classes for CardDefinition (with card_id) and CardInstance (with instance_id, upgrade_tier, upgrade_route). Define enums for Form (Base, U1A, U1B, Ultimate) and Route (A, B). Include fields for permanent_card_instance_modifiers. Ensure tier=2 implies route=null. Refs: ADR-0033, ADR-0020.
tasks.testStrategy: Write xUnit tests in Game.Core.Tests/Contracts to validate contract definitions and upgrade field constraints. Ensure no Godot dependencies. Refs: ADR-0033, ADR-0020.
tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down this task with a focus on Implement core contracts for card identity and forms.

tasks.details: Create classes for OfferLocking with fields: stable_ids[], display_order[], provenance (source_type, source_id, act, floor, node_id, difficulty, rng_stream, stream_pos), rng_stream, locked_at_save_point. Define RNG stream types (run, combat, event, loot, shop, offer). Ensure stable_ids use content stable IDs. Refs: ADR-0032.
tasks.testStrategy: Write xUnit tests to validate offer locking structure and provenance fields. Test serialization/deserialization for deterministic behavior. Refs: ADR-0032.
tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down this task with a focus on Implement core contracts for offer locking and deterministic outcomes.

Include methods for stacking, duration accumulation, and decay. Ensure RuleModifier and status.strength are non-dispellable. Refs: ADR-0021, ADR-0029.

tasks.expansionPrompt: Break down this task with a focus on Implement core contracts for status and modifier system.

tasks.title: Implement core contracts for combat loop and resolution pipeline
tasks.description: Define contracts for combat phases, damage calculation, and deterministic sequencing per Design Gates 01 and 03.
tasks.details: Create classes for CombatLoop with phases: StartOfTurn, Draw, Main, EndOfTurn. Define resolution pipeline steps: Validate, ComputeCost, PayCost, BeforePlayTriggers, ResolveEffect, AfterPlayTriggers, MoveCard, DeathCheck. Implement damage calculation with Strength, Weak, Vulnerable multipliers. Include OverplayTax logic for difficulty >=10. Refs: ADR-0021, ADR-0032.
tasks.testStrategy: Write xUnit tests for combat phase transitions, damage calculation, and OverplayTax application. Ensure deterministic ordering via combatant_id and stable_id. Refs: ADR-0021, ADR-0032.

subtasks.details: Implement and lock the step order Validate -> ComputeCost -> PayCost -> BeforePlayTriggers -> ResolveEffect -> AfterPlayTriggers -> MoveCard -> DeathCheck.

tasks.testStrategy: Run Godot project to verify autoloads load without startup errors. Write GdUnit4 tests to validate composition root wiring with at least two probe nodes, explicit InjectCompositionPorts(time,input,resourceLoader,dataStore,logger,eventBus) hook contract, non-hook rejection, signature-mismatch rejection, and faulty-hook failure reporting. tasks.title: Coverage thresholds as configurable soft/hard gate
tasks.description: Align xUnit coverage thresholds to the blueprint target (lines >= 90%, branches >= 85%) and allow overriding via environment variables. Provide soft/hard gate modes in scripts/python/run_dotnet.py and scripts/python/quality_gates.py.
tasks.details:
Story: PH13-BACKLOG-B1
ADR Refs: ADR-0005
Chapters: CH07
Test Refs: logs/unit/<date>/summary.json, logs/ci/<date>/quality-gates/summary.json, Tests/CI/CoverageThresholdOverridesTests.cs, Tests/CI/CoverageGateModeSoftHardTests.cs, Tests/CI/CoverageSummaryJsonEmissionTests.cs
Acceptance: In scripts/python/run_dotnet.py and scripts/python/quality_gates.py, the default xUnit coverage thresholds are lines>=90 and branches>=85, and the effective thresholds can be overridden via environment variables such that a run can demonstrate non-default thresholds without modifying code. Refs: Tests/CI/CoverageThresholdOverridesTests.cs; Both scripts provide a selectable soft/hard gate mode: when coverage is below the effective thresholds, soft mode completes with exit code 0 while recording a warning, and hard mode exits non-zero (failing the pipeline); when coverage meets/exceeds thresholds, both modes complete successfully with exit code 0. Refs: Tests/CI/CoverageGateModeSoftHardTests.cs; Coverage results are emitted as a single machine-readable summary JSON for CI consumption that includes (at minimum) measured line/branch coverage, the effective thresholds used (after env overrides), gate mode, and pass/fail outcome; the required summaries are present at logs/unit/<date>/summary.json and logs/ci/<date>/quality-gates/summary.json, and this work remains traceable to ADR-0005 and CH07 and the overlay docs docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md and docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Contracts-Quality-Metrics.md. Refs: Tests/CI/CoverageSummaryJsonEmissionTests.cs
Test Strategy: Run dotnet tests on Windows and verify threshold behavior by temporarily setting env vars.

Layer: ci
